name: Jules
desc: Cloud coding agent that returns pull requests
desc_zh: 做完直接交 pull request 的云端编码 Agent
solves: A chore described well enough does not need you watching it. Jules clones the repo to a cloud VM, plans, and comes back as a pull request.
solves_zh: 描述清楚的杂活不需要你盯着。Jules 把仓库克隆到云端 VM，做完计划，回来时是一个 pull request。
best_for: Version bumps, test backfills, small bugs — work with a clear finish line.
best_for_zh: 版本号更新、补测试、修小 bug——有明确终点线的那种活。
